summary: Core rootcause11 shared-harvest semantic evidence authority: repair the accepted deterministic review contract so one authenticated physical harvest/file evidence can bind the exact set of distinct same-harvest multiscale execution receipts without duplicating evidence or dropping receipt/scale conservation. Core-only producer contract and public fixture; Agent/Main remain downstream.
sourceRef: Original Plan Final Completion Definition bullets 6-9; Requirement Design §§10.5, 11.2, 11.6, 11.8, 18.1-18.3, 21; controller decision evt-20260728165834-0276; Alembic blocked rootcause10 report; Core@d0d33e49; Agent@2bf05831
designIntent: Preserve the existing dimension-free execution model: distinct obligation/scale execution receipts continue to share one physical harvest and exact frozen file executions. Version the semantic-review evidence authority/request/attestation inputs as needed so one evidence authority carries a canonical, tamper-evident exact receipt binding set for receipts that prove the same harvestKey/harvestReceiptHash and same frozen file execution, while conserving every distinct obligationId/analysisScale/receiptHash. Core validators must require union coverage of all requested receipts, reject overlap/omission/mixed-harvest/rebound evidence, retain legacy one-receipt compatibility where safe, serialize/reverify in a fresh process, and expose one public two-scale shared-harvest fixture/consumer contract for Agent. Do not duplicate Evidence Ledger entries, change harvest identity to include scale, drop schedules/receipts, or create another evidence/reviewer/store platform.

required.verify: One clean AlembicCore commit based exactly on d0d33e49cab732ec541bcfc3fb35447b6e2ad58d. Report parent/commit/tree/changed files; no Agent/Main/Plugin/Test/Wakeflow/vendor edits.

Show the current 2-scale schedule yields distinct obligationId/receiptHash but one harvestKey/harvestReceiptHash/file execution/evidence, and map why the existing one-authority/one-receipt coverage contract cannot represent it. State the chosen versioning and compatibility boundary.

A real Core schedule fixture with at least file+repository obligations over the same canonical subject must produce two conserved receipts and one harvest, then build one authenticated shared-harvest evidence authority whose exact receipt-binding set covers both receipts; serialize and validate in a fresh process through supported public exports.

Reject missing or extra receipt binding, duplicate/overlapping authority coverage, mixed harvestKey or harvestReceiptHash, changed obligationId/analysisScale/receiptHash, fileExecution/evidence/witness/blob/source rebound, partial/truncated execution, tampered/reordered non-canonical sets, and an authority set whose union does not exactly equal semanticRequest.executionReceipts. Preserve valid legacy single-receipt behavior.

Keep Core as deterministic contract/verifier owner. Preserve one physical harvest and raw Evidence Ledger authority, distinct multiscale schedule receipts, V3 trust-policy/signature durability, and production-facade mint restrictions. Do not implement Agent loading/signing, Main key custody/journal composition, or a second store/platform.

Run RED then GREEN focused StrictFactExecution and semantic-review authority/attestation suites, public/built/fresh-process probes, build:check/build, complete Core tests and repository boundary/retired/public gates, git diff --check, and Alembic Guard. Report exact counts and any proven pre-existing baseline issue separately.

targetTasks.summary: Implement and verify the Core public shared-harvest evidence-authority contract on exact d0d33e49, preserving distinct scale receipts and single physical harvest/evidence.
